title: Bidirectional DC-DC
source_docs: Powertrain Blockset/Energy Storage and Auxiliary Drive/DC-DC/Bidirectional_DC_DC.md
text: DC-to-DC converter that supports bidirectional boost and buck, 3 outputs, {Parameterize losses by} sets Loss calculation Single efficiency; {Converter response time constant, Tc} sets the constant, {Converter response initial voltage, Vinit} sets the voltage, {Converter power limit, Plimit} sets the power, {Overall DC to DC converter efficiency, eff} sets the constant, {Vector of voltages (v) for tabulated loss, v_loss_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Vector of currents (i) for tabulated loss, i_loss_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Corresponding losses, losses_table} sets the 2-D lookup table N -by, {Vector of voltages (v) for tabulated efficiency, v_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Vector of currents (i) for tabulated efficiency, i_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Corresponding efficiency, efficiency_table} sets the 2-D lookup table N -by and {Calibrate Maps} sets the calibrate tables with measured data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Parameterize losses by
params.values: Loss calculation Single efficiency measurement (default) | Tabulated loss data | Tabulated efficiency data
